steps.en: Notice is suspended after a foreigner converts to PR or citizen
steps.id: Notice disuspend setelah warga asing jadi PR atau warga negara
steps.why_en: Only this one conversion type is handled, and the daily job is switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Hanya jenis konversi ini yang ditangani, dan job hariannya dimatikan di setting production.

steps.en: Previous FIN, new NRIC and conversion date are saved
steps.id: FIN lama, NRIC baru, dan tanggal konversi disimpan
steps.why_en: The details are saved only in a background record, not shown to the officer, and the address is left out.
steps.why_id: Detail hanya disimpan di catatan latar belakang, tidak ditampilkan ke officer, dan alamat tidak ikut.

steps.en: A work item with the details is created
steps.why_en: This part is not built yet; the system only writes a note that it was skipped.
steps.why_id: Bagian ini belum dibangun; sistem hanya mencatat bahwa langkahnya dilewati.

steps.en: The work item arrives in the OIC's inbox
steps.id: Work item masuk ke inbox OIC
steps.why_en: There is no inbox page for the OIC; the menu entry is switched off.
steps.why_id: Belum ada halaman inbox untuk OIC; menunya dimatikan.

steps.en: OIC decides whether to keep pursuing the offender
steps.id: OIC memutuskan lanjut atau tidak menindaklanjuti offender
steps.why_en: The officer can only lift the hold by hand through a general screen, without the conversion details in front of them.
steps.why_id: Officer hanya bisa melepas suspend manual lewat layar umum, tanpa detail konversi di depannya.
